log: Working out who would actually buy this
Discovering candidates and exact source URLs (stage 1 of 2)
Fetching up to 10 exact URLs; validating against at most 48,000 characters
Evaluating candidates against 8 fetched pages (stage 2 of 2)

Coverage gaps and failures, stated rather than smoothed over. (1) Reddit is inaccessible to this agent (the domain is blocked), which removed the richest source of unguarded buyer voice for all six candidates; forum evidence came from Shopify Community instead, where the threads are thinner and partly answered by vendors. (2) G2, Capterra, TrustRadius and Indie Hackers all returned 403 to direct fetch, so the dissatisfaction-with-current-alternative evidence for the solo-founder and freelancer candidates exists only as search-engine summaries and has NOT been read at source — treat those claims as unverified until the pages are fetched by another route. (3) The Klaviyo page resolved in French, so the 'included in every paid subscription' quote is quoted in French with a translation; an English-locale re-read would be worth doing before using it in copy. (4) No named organisation examples are included: directory and listing searches for single-marketer DTC brands and small consultancies returned vendor roundups rather than evidence of pain or intent, and a directory would have demonstrated existence only. (5) No evidence at all was found for the invited-pilot segment outside the product's own material, and none is findable without naming private individuals, which is out of scope. (6) Searches that produced nothing usable: agency copy-capacity bottlenecks (returned SEO listicles), fractional CMO workflows (returned role-definition marketing), and GDPR guidance on reading contact details from company pages (returned scraping-vendor blogs, not regulator text) — so the compliance objection on the B2B services candidate remains unanswered rather than answered. (7) Population counts are unknown throughout; none were estimated. (8) Two product facts limit every candidate and no search can change them: there is no published price and no public proof of outcome.
6 audience(s) mapped; 0 worth exploring first. Commercial priority is a hypothesis, not a response-rate forecast.
